verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API with Bearer tokens, an npm SDK (@rippling/rippling-sdk) and an official MCP server, but nothing shows an official Rippling command-line tool. An SDK is a developer building block and an MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither counts toward a CLI. An IT/identity SaaS could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
